title: Phase 14 External Test Result
description: Structured format for pasting external test results back into Base44 (Admin → Test Results).

test_id.description: Unique test identifier (e.g. ci-build, e2e-login, k6-normal, iso-cross-org-A-B)

metrics.description: Free-form metrics: rps, p95, p99, error_rate, counts, bundle_size_kb, duration_ms, etc.

evidence.description: URLs or paths to logs, screenshots, artefacts
